Đọc rồi thay chi tiết cho đúng trải nghiệm của bạn.
samples.summaryVi: Lớp học cho người lớn cần vừa túi tiền và phù hợp giờ làm, đi lại, chăm con.

sections.label: Học suốt đời

questions.question: Are you interested in learning new skills as an adult?
questions.answer: Yes, I am, mainly because adults can update skills without returning to full-time study. I would like to understand how this works in everyday life, rather than just read a definition.
questions.noteVi: Trả lời trực tiếp → thêm một lý do.

questions.question: How could you learn more about learning new skills as an adult?
questions.answer: I could join an adult learning open evening. There, I would have a chance to try short classes and discuss flexible learning options. Trying something with other people usually helps me remember it.
questions.noteVi: Nêu một cách tìm hiểu và hoạt động cụ thể.

questions.question: Is there anything difficult about learning new skills as an adult?
questions.answer: One possible difficulty is that people with the greatest need may still be unable to attend. For example, a parent may miss an evening class because there is no one available to look after a child. I think it is better to recognise that problem early.
questions.noteVi: Một khó khăn → một ví dụ, không liệt kê quá nhiều.

sections.label: Kế hoạch cuối tuần & học cùng bạn bè

questions.question: What would you like to do with a friend this weekend?
questions.answer: I would like to try short classes and discuss flexible learning options. We could bring a weekly schedule and compare what we learn. It would give us something useful to talk about afterwards.
questions.noteVi: Nêu kế hoạch, đồ cần mang và lợi ích.

questions.question: Do you prefer learning something alone or with friends?
questions.answer: For a new topic, I prefer being with one or two friends. For instance, if we were learning about learning new skills as an adult, we could ask each other questions. However, I like reviewing my notes alone afterwards.
questions.noteVi: Chọn một phía, thêm tình huống và một ngoại lệ.

questions.question: How do you decide whether an activity is worth your time?
questions.answer: I ask whether I can use what I learn. In this case, it would be helpful to know how to offer flexible schedules and simple support for attendance. I also check the time and cost before making a plan.
questions.noteVi: Một tiêu chí → áp dụng vào tình huống → chi tiết thêm.
